definitions.explanation: The practice or science of slowing, preventing, or reversing the effects of aging on the body.

examples.japanese: {抗加齢|こうかれい}{医学|いがく}に{関心|かんしん}がある。
{抗加齢|こうかれい}{効果|こうか}があるとされるサプリメントが{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Supplements said to have anti-aging effects are popular.

examples.japanese: {抗加齢|こうかれい}の{分野|ぶんや}では、{食事|しょくじ}・{運動|うんどう}・{睡眠|すいみん}の{三|みっ}つが{基本|きほん}だと{言|い}われており、{特|とく}に{良質|りょうしつ}な{睡眠|すいみん}の{重要性|じゅうようせい}が{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: In the field of anti-aging, diet, exercise, and sleep are said to be the three basics, and the importance of quality sleep in particular is drawing attention.

notes:
A compound of {抗|こう} (anti-, against) and {加齢|かれい} (aging). This is the Japanese equivalent of the English loanword アンチエイジング, and both terms are widely used. {抗加齢|こうかれい} tends to appear in more technical or medical contexts, while アンチエイジング is more common in advertising and everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗加齢|こうかれい}{医学|いがく}: anti-aging medicine
- {抗加齢|こうかれい}{効果|こうか}: anti-aging effect
- {抗加齢|こうかれい}{治療|ちりょう}: anti-aging treatment
- {抗加齢|こうかれい}ケア: anti-aging care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アンチエイジング: anti-aging (English loanword, more casual/commercial)
- {若返|わかがえ}り: rejuvenation (native Japanese term)
- {老化防止|ろうかぼうし}: prevention of aging
